name: Isomori Natsuko
source:
"I understand. I love Shou-chan too."

Shouma's older sister. She has a laid-back, easygoing personality and adores her little brother.

She seems to be Yoruhiko's classmate...?

[Translated from [url=https://nenaico.com/samaao/chara10.html]official website[/url]]
